name: Techno
description: A techno track that grows slowly: parts come in every 16 bars, one breakdown, and a long outro. 160 bars.

sections.name: Intro
sections.tip: Kick and percussion only, for a DJ to mix in.

sections.name: Groove
sections.tip: Bring in the bass and the main loop; add or change one part every 8 or 16 bars.

sections.name: Build-up
sections.tip: More tension: open filters, add noise and percussion.

sections.name: Breakdown
sections.tip: Take the kick out and let a pad or a stab carry the track.

sections.name: Peak
sections.tip: The kick comes back with everything: the most intense part.

sections.name: Outro
sections.tip: Strip back to the kick and percussion, for a DJ to mix out.
